segments.expected: Nobody answered her; the clerk looked at the ledger. Kiva thought about a can of civic stock in the Works' store, in the autumn, that somebody had found cut with soot and put down and nobody had taken up, and about a carter who kept his winter boots on the top shelf of a cupboard, and about thirty years of hard winters on the Levee end. She did not say any of it, because it was not hers to say to a woman in black at a counter.

segments.expected: "Sealed, medical, W, plain," said Jude, at the table by the door, writing in the team book. "Eight-tenths, off a husk on the Sag in the fourth month, 2680. One and two-tenths, given at the house of the Even Hand on Friday the 27th of the second month, to make good what eased M. Rowan's hand. Two drams." He stopped writing. "For a hand. Not for a bank, a floor, a crossing or a sale. I've put that under both lines. I'd want it under both."

segments.expected: It was long and low and built of grey stone, with a slate roof and a great many chimneys, and a wall round it, and inside the wall the tops of bare trees. It stood on its bluff with its back to the Sag and its face to the river and the south, quite plain, like a farm. There was smoke going up from three of its chimneys. There were no lights.

segments.expected: They ate at dusk, at the long table, with eleven sisters in grey who did not speak during the meal and did not seem to mind that their guests did. After supper the sister from the gate came and stood at Kiva's elbow and said, "The Master."

segments.expected: All three of them. She felt it happen, and could not have stopped it, and did not want to. The Ember under her breastbone, which was always awake, which had come gladly to every call since she was thirteen, went still. The hand door, close, under the skin of her palms, went still. The still door, heavy and slow under everything, which she had thought could not go any stiller, went still in a way that she had no word for, as a pond goes still when the wind drops. They did not shut. They had not been asked to shut. They lay down where they were, as dogs lie down in a room when somebody comes into it whom they do not know and do not need to watch.
